tonight.headline: Two empty slots and Love at QB: fix them before Wednesday
body: Bad news first: Week 7 is lost, 105.22 to 89.76, and AVIATO are 2-5. As set, Week 8 projects 97.9 to Guillo-tinas' 88.8 — but that lineup has Love at quarterback and zeros at tight end and kicker.
Three moves take it to about 129: Allen in before Thursday 18:15, claims on Hockenson and Bass before 01:00 Wednesday, and Tuten into the RB slot.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Guillo-tinas start Kittle on a 49ers bye and bench Puka Nacua (22.5); Lamar Jackson is out. Their 88.8 understates them by 20+ once they set it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A failed claim leaves the tight-end or kicker slot at zero; Henry and the free-agent pool on Wednesday are the cover.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Thu 29 Oct 18:15 CDMX — Love's kickoff
doFirst.title: Allen back in at quarterback, Love out
doFirst.subtitle: Love is still in the QB slot from Buffalo's bye. He plays Thursday night — once that game starts he locks there and Allen cannot come in.

case.label: The move
case.body: Josh Allen returns from the Week 7 bye; Buffalo host Baltimore in the week's highest total, 53.5, with Buffalo implied at 28.5 (FootballNation 26 Oct). Allen 24.1 against Love's 17.2: a 6.9-point projection gap.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Green Bay–Carolina kicks off Thursday 18:15 CDMX (league file). Make the swap today. If the Hockenson claim processes Wednesday it drops Love anyway — but do not rely on the claim to fix the QB slot.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love outscores Allen in Week 8 (archive), graded on the outcome. Void if Allen is hurt before kickoff.

doFirst.sources: League file 12:50Z · FootballNation BAL–BUF 26 Oct · SI Bills 26 Oct

doFirst.title: Claim T.J. Hockenson, drop Jordan Love
doFirst.subtitle: Likely's Giants are on bye and Chem carries one tight end: the slot scores zero without a claim. Put Hunter Henry in as a second claim, same drop, ranked below.

case.label: The player
case.body: Kyler Murray's tight end — Fabiano says Hockenson 'has Murray's trust' and scored double digits in his last two full games (SI 26 Oct); 5 targets and 13.5 in Week 7 (archive). Minnesota visit Detroit, last in the league against the pass at 291.8 yards a game (FootballNation 26 Oct).

case.label: The drop
case.body: Love's only job — Buffalo's Week 7 bye — is done (17.0, archive). Chem starts one quarterback and Allen is back; Love's own bye is Week 11, not a reason to carry him.

case.label: Contested
case.body: Yahoo's 26 Oct column prefers Henry: Maye heating up, Doubs and Hollins on IR, double digits in four straight. ESPN projects Hockenson 11.8 to Henry's 10.6; that is the call, and Henry is the backup claim, not the loser.

case.label: The cost
case.body: Chem's priority resets weekly and AVIATO sit 3rd. Order: Hockenson, then Henry (same drop — it fails harmlessly if Hockenson lands), then Bass.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Henry outscores Hockenson in Week 8 (archive), or Hockenson draws under four targets with Murray playing.

doFirst.sources: SI (Fabiano) 26 Oct · Yahoo 26 Oct · FootballNation MIN–DET 26 Oct · ESPN archive

doFirst.title: Claim Tyler Bass, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Houston are on bye and Chem carries one kicker. Bass kicks in the week's highest total.

case.label: The player
case.body: Buffalo host Baltimore at a 53.5 total, Buffalo implied 28.5 (FootballNation 26 Oct); Yahoo's 27 Oct streamer list has him fifth, expecting red-zone stalls. Highest-projected kicker on the wire (9.9; Ryland 9.1).

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn (93% rostered) is on bye and kickers are streamed here (STRATEGY §5) — dropping him disagrees with the market only in that a kicker is replaceable every week. If you would rather keep him, drop Kamara instead, also on bye and behind Kendre Miller in New Orleans.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Ryland or Little, both free, outscore Bass in Week 8 by more than three points (archive).

doFirst.sources: Yahoo kicker streamers 27 Oct · FootballNation BAL–BUF 26 Oct

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Thu 29 Oct 18:15 CDMX — Coker's kickoff
doFirst.title: Set the projection lineup: Tuten at RB, Gordon to flex, Coker at WR
doFirst.subtitle: Bench Metcalf and Wilson. Tuten over Metcalf is a 2.6-point projection call; Coker over Wilson is a coin flip that goes to the projection.

case.label: The move
case.body: Tuten returns from the Jaguars' bye as the lead back, with Jacksonville 7.5-point home favourites (Fox Sports, 26 Oct). Gordon slides to the flex, which Chem fills from RB or WR. Metcalf is projected 12.2 behind a Browns defence 7th against the pass (FootballNation).

case.label: Coker
case.body: Coker 14.6, Wilson 14.1: a coin flip, so the projection decides and nothing more is argued. Coker is questionable with a shoulder and plays Thursday; if he is inactive at 16:45, Wilson goes back in.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Metcalf outscores Tuten in Week 8 (archive), graded on the outcome.

doFirst.sources: lineup_check.py · Fox Sports Week 8 lines · Packers.com 26 Oct

whatWentWrong.title: Week 7 lost by 15.46 — Lamb and Pierce scored 36.2 on Monday night
whatWentWrong.lead: JuiceJam 105.22, AVIATO 89.76. They needed 20.75 from two players and got 36.2.

case.label: What happened
case.body: CeeDee Lamb 24.4 (two TDs) and Dameon Pierce 11.8 in Dallas's 38-21 win, after Barkley left with a back injury (archive; PFT 26 Oct). 8.6 points sat on the AVIATO bench (Kamara 13.2 in the flex, Metcalf to WR for Wilson's 4.6) — not enough to have won.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the method: Metcalf over Kamara was a 6.7-point projection call. What it changes is the record — 2-5 — and the cost of every slot that scores zero. Week 8 has two of them (Likely, Fairbairn), which is why both claims above matter more than any start/sit.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing to re-grade; Week 7 is final in the archive (07:05Z).

whatWentWrong.title: Two zero-point slots unless you claim before 01:00 Wednesday
whatWentWrong.lead: Likely (Giants) and Fairbairn (Texans) are on bye, and Chem carries no second tight end and no second kicker.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Houston, the Giants, New Orleans and San Francisco share the Week 8 bye (Fox Sports). Love, the Week 7 cover, is still in the QB slot.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Claims for Hockenson (Henry behind him) and Bass, and the Allen swap before Thursday. Together they take the lineup from 97.7 projected to about 129.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Either claim lost to a team above AVIATO (3rd) and no tight end or kicker added Wednesday from free agency.
